# Firebird Realty

> Firebird Realty is a Florida buyer's agent serving Ormond Beach, Daytona Beach, and Central Florida. Led by Larisa Seibel — licensed Florida realtor with 21+ years of experience. Specializes in first-time homebuyers, new Americans, and bilingual English & Russian-speaking buyers.

## About

Firebird Realty is led by Larisa Seibel (License BK3563702), a Florida buyer's agent based in Ormond Beach, FL. Larisa has been helping buyers navigate the Florida real estate market since 2003. She is fluent in English and Russian and specializes in representing first-time buyers, new American families, and anyone who needs a patient, knowledgeable advocate on their side.

- [Home](https://firebirdrealty.net)

## Services

- Buyer representation — Larisa works exclusively for buyers, not sellers
- First-time homebuyer guidance — step-by-step support from pre-approval through closing
- New Americans real estate — helping immigrant families understand the Florida home buying process
- Bilingual service — English and Russian
- Relocation assistance — helping buyers moving to Central Florida from out of state or country
- Market analysis and neighborhood tours
